name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A collapsible accordion component with filled, stroke, and connected list variants. Includes a composed Accordion.Group for quick usage. Built on Radix Accordion with namespace exports.

docs.lead: A collapsible accordion component with filled, stroke, and connected list variants. Built on Radix Accordion for full accessibility.
docs.usage:
import * as Accordion from "@/components/ui/accordion"

<Accordion.Root type="single" collapsible>
  <Accordion.Item value="a">
    <Accordion.Trigger>
      <Accordion.Icon as={Icon} />
      Title
      <Accordion.Arrow />
    </Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content>Content</Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>

examples.title: Default (Filled)
examples.description: Default filled variant with icons. Items fill with a background color when open.
examples.code:
<Accordion.Root type='single' collapsible className='space-y-6'>
  <Accordion.Item value='a'>
    <Accordion.Trigger>
      <Accordion.Icon as={RiAccountCircleLine} />
      How do I update my account information?
      <Accordion.Arrow />
    </Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content className='px-[30px]'>
      Insert the accordion description here.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>

examples.title: Arrow Start
examples.description: Arrow positioned at the start of the trigger instead of the end.
examples.code:

</Accordion.Root>

examples.title: Stroke Variant

examples.code:

    </Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content className='px-[30px]'>
      Content
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>

examples.title: Stroke with Arrow Start

examples.code:

examples.title: List (Connected)
examples.description: Connected list variant. Items are joined inside one bordered container, separated by top dividers, with a chevron-in-a-button arrow that rotates open. The container styling lives on Accordion.Root, the list variant on each Accordion.Item.
examples.code:
<Accordion.Root
  type='single'
  collapsible
  className='overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-stroke-soft-200 bg-bg-white-0 shadow-regular-xs'
>
  <Accordion.Item value='a' variant='list'>
    <Accordion.Trigger className='py-4 pr-3 pl-5'>
      <Accordion.Icon as={RiUser3Line} />
      Business profile
      <Accordion.Chevron />
    </Accordion.Trigger>
    <Accordion.Content className='px-5 pt-0 pb-4 pl-[50px]'>
      Manage your company details shown across the platform.
    </Accordion.Content>
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>

examples.title: Group (Composed)

examples.title: Group List (Connected)

api.name: Accordion.Root
api.description: The root container. Wraps Radix Accordion.Root.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or multiple items can be open at a time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing all items

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. Filled fills with background on open, stroke keeps a border, list joins items into a connected, divider-separated container (container styling applied on Accordion.Root)

api.name: Accordion.Trigger
api.description: The clickable header that toggles the content.

api.name: Accordion.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon slot for the trigger. Renders any icon component via the `as` prop.

api.name: Accordion.Arrow
api.description: Toggle indicator that shows +/- icons based on open state.

props.name: openIcon
props.description: Icon shown when the item is closed

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Icon shown when the item is open

api.name: Accordion.Chevron
api.description: Toggle indicator used by the list variant. Renders a chevron inside a bordered button box that rotates 180° when the item is open.

props.name: icon
props.description: The chevron icon component to render

api.name: Accordion.Content
api.description: The collapsible content area with slide animation.

api.name: Accordion.Group
api.description: Composed accordion that renders items from props. Handles arrow placement and content padding automatically.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of items with value, title, content, and optional icon

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style applied to all items. The list variant renders a connected container with a chevron arrow

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or multiple items can be open at a time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing all items
